Find the contexts that make a given next state likely or unlikely

Source: R/mine.R
mine_contexts.Rd

mine_contexts() finds the contexts that make a given next state likely or unlikely. It scans every context of a fitted tree for the probability it gives one chosen next state and returns the contexts whose probability lies in a requested range, from the highest probability down. This serves questions about one outcome state, such as after which histories disengagement is most likely, or after which histories a learner almost never returns to planning.

Each row reports the context, its depth and count, the probability of the chosen state after it, and whether that state is the context's most likely next state. Probabilities in rare contexts are imprecise; set min_count to keep only contexts with enough occurrences. To compare the state's probability across groups, fit a grouped tree and use compare_groups().

Usage

mine_contexts(tree, state, min_prob = NULL, max_prob = NULL, min_count = 1L)

Arguments

tree

A transitiontrees object.

state

The next state of interest, one of the tree's states.

min_prob, max_prob

Keep contexts whose probability of state is at least min_prob and at most max_prob. NULL (default) leaves that bound open.

min_count

Keep contexts that occurred at least this many times. Default 1.

Value

A data.frame with one row per context and columns pathway, depth, count, state, prob (probability of state after the context) and is_modal (whether state is the most likely next state), sorted by prob and then count, both decreasing. No matching context gives a zero-row table with these columns.

Conditions

transitiontrees_bad_input when tree is not a fitted tree or state is not a single one of its states.

See also

query_pathway(), sharp_pathways(), mine_sequences().

Examples

tree <- context_tree(trajectories, max_depth = 3)
mine_contexts(tree, state = "Disengaged", min_prob = 0.4, min_count = 10)
#>                                  pathway depth count      state      prob
#> 1 Disengaged -> Disengaged -> Disengaged     3    81 Disengaged 0.7037037
#> 2               Disengaged -> Disengaged     2   139 Disengaged 0.6762590
#> 3    Average -> Disengaged -> Disengaged     3    45 Disengaged 0.6000000
#> 4       Average -> Disengaged -> Average     3    64 Disengaged 0.4843750
#> 5                             Disengaged     1   325 Disengaged 0.4830769
#> 6       Average -> Average -> Disengaged     3    62 Disengaged 0.4032258
#> 7        Disengaged -> Active -> Average     3    10 Disengaged 0.4000000
#>   is_modal
#> 1     TRUE
#> 2     TRUE
#> 3     TRUE
#> 4     TRUE
#> 5     TRUE
#> 6    FALSE
#> 7    FALSE
mine_contexts(tree, state = "Active", max_prob = 0.05)
#>                               pathway depth count  state       prob is_modal
#> 1 Average -> Disengaged -> Disengaged     3    45 Active 0.02222222    FALSE
#> 2 Disengaged -> Disengaged -> Average     3    31 Active 0.00100000    FALSE
#> 3     Active -> Disengaged -> Average     3     7 Active 0.00100000    FALSE
